tei:div.tei:p: El Malé Raħamim, the Prayer for the Dead, is recited in the Yizkor service on special days of the year. The prayer has been adapted for various groups on these and other memorial days, notably for victims of the Holocaust. This adaptation commemorates victims of lethal hate-crimes against Transgender people. This version was originally written for Queer Jews at Brandeis’s Transgender Day of Remembrance Services on 20 November 2024.
This adaptation of El Malé Raḥamim for Transgender Day of Remembrance was prepared by Nathaniel Jacobs for Queer Jews at Brandeis‘s Transgender Day of Remembrance Services on 20 November 2024.
